newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes stable at slightly firmer price levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes stable at slightly firmer price levels.

text.p: U.S. crudes stablized Wednesday afternoon at slightly higher ranges for November outright and grade differentials, traders said.

Fundamental bullishness in the heating oil market has carried over to the crude sector, boosting futures and cash crude. NYMEX heating oil made a new post-Gulf War high at 73.15 cts a gallon for the November spot contract.
Traders said the cash market was firmed by refiner buying at a time of low distillate stocks.
November West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around 5 cts higher at $24.15-$24.25 in afternoon activity.
